scenarios.intent: Measure and improve a functioning but slow software system without trading away correctness, compatibility or maintainability.
mustPreserve: reproducible baseline before optimization
functional and compatibility invariants
evidence-linked dominant hotspot
measured post-change verification and regression guard
mustNotDo: optimize from intuition without a representative baseline
prefer cosmetic micro-optimization over the dominant measured bottleneck

scenarios.intent: Redesign a responsive product surface while preserving product, brand and design authority and proving visual completion by render review.
mustPreserve: PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md authority
corporate palette and brand provenance when applicable
desktop and mobile render evidence
review-fix-rerender loop
mustNotDo: invent brand colors or replace authoritative corporate tokens
declare design complete from green CI without visual review

scenarios.intent: Take a contract matter from clarified requirements and legal context through review or drafting, negotiation and redlines to a controlled legal final gate.
mustPreserve: applicable-law uncertainty until verified
review and drafting as distinct work products
issue lineage across redlines
authority and counsel gates before final readiness
mustNotDo: claim legal certainty from an unverified default jurisdiction
erase material review findings by immediately rewriting the clause

scenarios.intent: Research a person's public professional and scientific record, disambiguate identity and deliver an evidence-bound polished report with optional document artifacts.
mustPreserve: identity disambiguation before broad publication or patent attribution
source-bound biography and career claims
fidelity through language revision
document rendering does not re-author research conclusions
mustNotDo: perform invasive private profiling outside the workflow scope
attribute publications or patents from name similarity alone

scenarios.intent: Create or revise an editable presentation from an authoritative template or reference deck with presentation-specific language and real render and PDF quality gates.
mustPreserve: template or reference authority
semantic fidelity during language rewriting
structural layout checks separated from visual render checks
editable PPTX and derived PDF parity
mustNotDo: invent a corporate design when no authoritative brand source exists
treat collision-free layout as sufficient visual quality

scenarios.intent: Turn one accessible YouTube video into an evidence-bound learning model and requested multi-format outputs without inventing missing process parameters.
mustPreserve: source identity and access constraints
speech and visual evidence distinction
observed derived and recommended procedure classes
one canonical learning-content fingerprint across delivery formats
mustNotDo: bypass access controls or reproduce long transcripts
invent critical SOP parameters missing from the evidence

scenarios.intent: Synthesize multiple YouTube videos into one learning model only after individual evidence analysis, source arbitration, conflict handling and provenance-preserving deduplication.
mustPreserve: individual source analysis before synthesis
source independence and authority rather than majority vote
explicit unresolved material conflicts
single multi-source model for all delivered formats
mustNotDo: convert repeated dependent claims into independent confirmation
smooth conflicting procedures into an unsupported hybrid SOP

scenarios.intent: Build a structured learning path from multi-video evidence using prerequisite logic, observable objectives and formative activities before shared multi-format delivery.
mustPreserve: acyclic prerequisite graph based on learning dependency rather than playlist order
observable objectives and exit criteria
evidence-linked formative activities
same course fingerprint across requested formats
mustNotDo: claim psychometric validation or certification without evidence
copy playlist order as the course prerequisite structure

scenarios.intent: Run longitudinal athlete management from goals and periodization through daily monitoring and specialist prescriptions to evidence-based plan adaptation.
mustPreserve: goal and periodization hierarchy
daily evidence separated from long-term adaptation inference
specialist ownership of strength endurance recovery and fueling prescriptions
auditable plan revision rather than silent schedule drift
mustNotDo: route a normal one-shot plan through the deprecated sport-training-programming facade
override health or safety constraints merely to preserve the calendar

scenarios.intent: Turn a growing unstructured thought journal into a goal-driven semantic graph and structured concept without forcing an early outline onto incomplete ideas.
mustPreserve: confirmed goal frame before final concept structure
raw thought capture before premature categorization
semantic links between goals ideas risks questions and actions
traceability from concept structure back to captured thoughts
mustNotDo: force chronological notes directly into a final outline
ask again for requirements already answered in earlier grilling rounds

scenarios.intent: Make a physical product purchase decision from explicit requirements, product evidence, current price and availability, and a transparent comparison ranking.
mustPreserve: decision requirements and hard constraints
separation of product evidence from current commercial availability
transparent ranking criteria and trade-offs
fresh price and availability snapshot when relevant
mustNotDo: rank products from price alone when decision criteria are broader
present stale availability as a current purchasing fact

scenarios.intent: Plan a private trip from explicit travel requirements through evidence-backed destination, transport and stay research, current market availability, transparent ranking and a spatially and temporally feasible itinerary.
mustPreserve: confirmed travel requirements and hard constraints across all downstream workers
separation of relatively stable travel evidence from time-stamped current availability and prices
hard feasibility gates before weighted option ranking
spatial and temporal feasibility including transfers and required buffers before itinerary completion
mustNotDo: invent missing travel preferences or weights to force a recommendation
present stale prices or availability as current booking facts
treat the cheapest itinerary as the best itinerary without applying confirmed decision criteria
perform a financially committing booking action without explicit user authorization
